hero.title: Youth transforming education
hero.subtitle: We are an NGO that designs and implements free educational programs in Argentina.

items.name: Sofía Martínez
items.content: FLA showed me that there is a world of opportunities within my reach and made me see that I am capable of achieving anything I set my mind to. It made me feel confident and fearless.

items.name: Camila Díaz
items.content: From the very first moment, FLA makes you feel unique, special, and supported. It shows you and gives you many opportunities to reach your goals and set new ones.

cards.title: Social Impact
cards.description: Because we encourage those who participate in our programs to carry out projects that generate transformations in their communities.

cards.title: Education
cards.description: Because we believe in education as a resource and tool to solve social problems.

cards.title: Opportunities
cards.description: Because we believe that talent has no borders, we bring transformative experiences to the most remote corners, so that every young person can be an agent of change in their community.

introduction.title: THE FOUNDATION
introduction.subtitle: The Leaders of Ansenuza Foundation is a non-governmental organization based in Miramar de Ansenuza, Córdoba, whose work revolves around the design and execution of educational programs in Argentina.
introduction.paragraph1_part3: (FLA), we believe in the potential of every young person to transform their community and build a better future. Our mission is to train change agents, offering opportunities, tools, and support for young people to develop leadership and generate social impact.
introduction.paragraph2: We work throughout Argentina, with special attention to rural and semi-urban regions, as well as large cities. Our goal is to reach those who need it most, providing experiential experiences, without economic barriers, that promote learning through action and innovation.
introduction.paragraph3: FLA not only focuses on training leaders, but on creating an inclusive, diverse, and committed community, where young people find a safe space to enhance their ideas and sustainable projects.
introduction.paragraph4_part1: Being at FLA means being part of a
introduction.paragraph4_part2: movement that is committed to equal opportunities and the power of youth to generate a real and lasting impact.
introduction.paragraph4_part3: Together, we are building a future full of possibilities and leadership for everyone.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: To empower young people from all over the country to be leaders through educational and motivational programs, providing support for development opportunities that allow them to carry out social impact projects.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: A world in which new generations have access to quality education, which allows them to decide freely and have the motivation to become leaders and positively transform their communities.
